definitions.explanation: Observable actions and mannerisms, especially when they seem suspicious or unusual.

examples.japanese: {挙動|きょどう}⟦{不審|ふしん}→不審：16934_fushin⟧な⟦{人物|じんぶつ}→人物：03356_jinbutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}かけた→見かける：01644_mikakeru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{挙動|きょどう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦おかしかった→おかしい：00875_okashii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけた→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
examples.english: His behavior seemed strange, so I called out to him.

examples.japanese: ⟦{警備員|けいびいん}→警備員：09867_keibiin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{入場者|にゅうじょうしゃ}→入場者：23599_nyuujousha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{挙動|きょどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注意深|ちゅういぶか}く→注意深い：16848_chuuibukai⟧⟦{観察|かんさつ}していた→観察する：21989_kansatsusuru⟧。
examples.english: The security guard was carefully observing the behavior of those entering.

notes:
USAGE:
{挙動|きょどう} is a relatively formal word referring to observable behavior and physical movements. It is most commonly used in the compound {挙動|きょどう}⟦{不審|ふしん}→不審：16934_fushin⟧ (suspicious behavior), which is standard police and security terminology.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {挙動|きょどう}⟦{不審|ふしん}→不審：16934_fushin⟧ (suspicious behavior)
- {挙動|きょどう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦おかしい→おかしい：00875_okashii⟧ (to be behaving strangely)
- {挙動|きょどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{監視|かんし}→監視：05521_kanshi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to monitor someone's movements)
